_note: Six plausible milestones. Replace years and text with the real history.

events.title: The first bench
events.description: Shri Ashok Kumar Bansal opens a single-bench workshop in South Delhi, making to order for a handful of families.

events.title: The move to Malviya Nagar
events.description: The house takes the premises at C-50, beside Laxmi Narayan Mandir, where it still stands.

events.title: Manufacturing brought fully in-house
events.description: Casting, setting and polishing move under one roof, ending all reliance on outside workshops.

events.title: The second generation joins
events.description: Chetan and Karan Bansal begin at the bench before taking on the front of house.

events.title: The showroom is rebuilt
events.description: Grey Italian marble, black marble walls, nine seating areas and a private cabin.

events.title: Thirty years
events.description: Many of the families who came in the first decade now bring their children.
